title: Göbekli Tepe chalices and burial rituals

tellings.quote: But Brian also mentions archaeologically excavated chalices at Göbekli Tepe, which dates back 12,000 years ago, right before the agrarian revolution.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to Brian Muraresku, author of a book called The Immortality Key, who mentions drinking cups dug up at Göbekli Tepe, an ancient site about 12,000 years old. Michels says this dates to just before people began farming, and ties the cups to burial rituals. He brings it up in an episode about mushrooms, hinting that people may have used mind-altering drinks in ritual from very early on.
